evals.input: ACME Co isn't renewing after month 3. Help me offboard them properly.
expect: Runs through the full offboarding checklist in order
Lists all platform access items to transfer or revoke
Produces the final engagement summary document template
Recommends requesting a brief exit conversation
Prompts to ask for a testimonial and case study
Notes to archive (not delete) the client folder

evals.input: The client is leaving on bad terms — they're unhappy with results. How do I handle the offboarding?
expect: Recommends acknowledging what didn't go well before the client raises it
Emphasises completing all contractual obligations regardless of relationship quality
Advises documenting all communications and deliveries in case of dispute
